title: 钓台
author: 洪升
subtitle: 【清诗别裁集】清·洪升
baihua_lines: 逃却高名远俗尘，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，

The wanderer think of the vast expanse.
As she listen to the path ahead, we share our thoughts and memories.

Melancholy fills my breast, and the poet wander through the quiet scene.
